'''Mannock T'sank''' was a large [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era that followed the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3649 BBY]], T'sank beat the first-year student [[Jura Ostrogoth]] into unconsciousness before stripping him naked and tying him to a bunk. Before T'sank could further abuse the new [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]], he was knocked out by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Scopique]], who attacked him from behind.<ref name="Red Harvest" />
